snippet.description:
Does your back hurt during long classes? Does your neck feel stiff after studying? Do you get wrist pain while writing answers?

Dr. Rachita Luthra joins LevelUp IAS to answer common questions about posture, long sitting hours and discomfort during UPSC preparation.

𝑷𝑶𝑺𝑻𝑼𝑹𝑬, 𝑷𝑨𝑰𝑵 & 𝑴𝑶𝑽𝑬𝑴𝑬𝑵𝑻 𝑫𝑼𝑹𝑰𝑵𝑮 𝑼𝑷𝑺𝑪 𝑷𝑹𝑬𝑷𝑨𝑹𝑨𝑻𝑰𝑶𝑵
𝐑𝐞𝐠𝐢𝐬𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝐍𝐨𝐰: https://shorturl.at/xhZuA

📅 25 October | 10 AM 
📍 LevelUp IAS, New Delhi

Long study hours causing neck or back pain?

Join our free offline workshop with Dr. Rachita Luthra, Musculoskeletal Physiotherapist, to learn how to take better care of your body during UPSC preparation.

In conversation with Sonali Ma’am, Counselling Psychologist & UPSC Mindset Coach.
